member.summary:
Returns true if this (project, challenge, nonce) has NOT been used yet and we successfully marked it used. Returns false if it's already used (replay).
NOTE: IDistributedCache does not guarantee atomic "set-if-not-exists". This is still very effective for v1, and becomes fully robust if you later swap in Redis with SET NX.
